root_cause: bg_experimenten_beoordelen compares the same page before versus during, so general traffic movement is indistinguishable from the effect of a change; a keep decision cannot be made autonomously.
fix: Read-only difference-in-differences function over unchanged pages; consistent only with enough sample, a stable control and a positive difference.
prevention_rule: An uplift is only treated as an effect of the change when the control group is stable and the tested page outperforms it.
terminal_rule: Not terminal until the function is applied, wired into the autonomous decision gate and a first experiment shows a computed control group in production.
